Name: Thievery - a sneaky skill
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]
Introduces a new mechanic to Stardew Valley, "Thievery" that interacts with the social system in a whole new way. Lose friendship but have a chance to gain loot or entry into places you shouldn't be! There are three core pillars / ideas to the skill
[list]
[*]Pickpocketing
[list]
[*]After talking with a giftable NPC once, You can go up to them and hit the Steal key (default: B) [/*]
[*]Many things affect how sneaky you are such as; the direction you are vs the direction the NPC is, weather, if you're outside and it's dark out, daily luck, ect. [/*]
[*]You will lose friendship with them but they have a chance to drop an item they like or love. The friendship lose is based on many factors (as stated above). [/*]
[*]The item you gained has a value cap of your thievery level * 175 (so no getting a prismatic gem early on!)[/*]
[*]This counts as a gift for the week! You can only steal villagers twice per week. [/*]
[*] Afterwards, the skill will go on cooldown. [/*]
[*][b][i]You can also pickpocket from monsters and there is a config option to make it so you may only pickpocket from monsters. Stealing from monsters also deals damage to them and causes knockback.[/i][/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Lock picking
[list]
[*]You can turn wood + a metal bar (Copper, Iron, Gold, or Iridium) into lock picks based on your skill level.[/*]
[*]You can lock pick into a door and it will be unlocked for you for the day (to prevent softlocks). [/*]
[*]This has a chance to breaks the lock pick, with copper picks having a 90% break chance and iridium having a 30% break chance.[/*]
[*]Skill level lowers the chance of a lock pick breaking.[/*]
[*]Lose friendship with those who see with in 10 tiles enter a place with a lock pick.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Shoplifting
[list]
[*]You can shoplift from most stores, even modded stores! That said, some stores that are catalogues or special can not be shoplifted from. You can even shoplift from stores that lack gold currency (I.E. they use Coral or books)[/*]
[*]To shoplift an item, you need to have the sell price value of the item.[/*]
[*]Hold the Steal key and click on the item you want to try to shoplift.[/*]
[*]You have a 25% chance to get caught when shoplifting. [/*]
[*]This chance gets reduced based on your thieving level. [/*]
[*]This chance gets increased based on the value of the item vs your thieving skill level (is it beyond your thieving level cap?)[/*]
[*]The more your shoplift per day, the higher chances of you getting caught. [/*]
[*][b][i]Getting Caught shoplifting has serious downsides; [/i][/b]You lose 75 friendship with all NPCs with in a 25 tile radius, and get banned from the shop for 5 in game days. [/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGFY8Nd.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Level 5: Pickpocket - Direction no longer affects pickpicketing chance.
[list]
[*]Level 10: Highwayman - You now pickpocket from multiple people NPCs around you at once.[/*]
[*]Level 10: Mugger - You gain 25% of your max Health and Stamina when you pickpocket.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Level 5: Robin hood - Chance to avoid friendship loss from thieving actions.
[list]
[*]Level 10: Phantom - Gain better rewards and leave fewer traces when thieving[/*]
[*]Level 10: Rogue - Improves your chance of successful thieving actions[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img]

[b][i]All config values are cached at day start to save processing power, with the exception of the skill icon (which needs a restart).[/i][/b]
[list]
[*]Action Key: change the stealing key (default: B)[/*]
[*]Thief Skill icon: Changes what icon the thievery skill uses[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Pickpocketing
[list]
[*]Monsters only: change it so you can only pickpocket from monsters[/*]
[*]Short Cooldown: reduces cooldown to only 10 minutes[/*]
[*]Exp Modifier: This changes the overall exp you get from pickpocketing[/*]
[*]Exp from a fail: the exp you get when you completely fail to pickpocket[/*]
[*]Exp from a tier 1 success[/*]
[*]Exp from a tier 2 success[/*]
[*]Exp from a tier 3 success[/*]
[*]Exp from a tier 4 success[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Lockpicking
[list]
[*]Lockpicking EXP: how much exp you get from opening a door with a lockpick[/*]
[*]Lockpicking witness radius: how many tiles away NPCs can notice the player lockpicking[/*]
[*]Lockpicking friendship lost: how much friendship nearby NPCs lose when they witness the player lockpicking.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Shoplifting
[list]
[*]Shoplift value per level: how much internal item value each thievery level safely covers before adding additional catch chance.[/*]
[*]Base catch chance: the base chance to get caught before other modifiers.[/*]
[*]Catch Chance Reduction per level: how much caught chance is reduced per thievery level[/*]
[*]Catch chance per attempt today: how much caught chance is added for each shoplifting attempt done that day.[/*]
[*]Catch chance per step over limit: how much caught chance is added for each item value step above the player's thievery level[/*]
[*]Shop ban days: how many days the player is banned from a shop after being caught shoplifting[/*]
[*]Shoplifting success exp: how much exp you get from shoplifting when not caught[/*]
[*]Shoplifting caught exp: how much exp you get from shoplifting when caught[/*]
[*]Shoplifting witness radius: how many tiles away NPCs can witness the player getting caught shoplifting[/*]
[*]Shoplifting friendship lost: how much friendship is lost when you are caught shoplifting[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
